_comment: v1.0.0-recovery-testing durability mutation gate (guideline §2.3/§3.6). §2.3 requires StrykerJS mutation on AT LEAST FOUR durability adapters; this mutates FIVE — save-and-advance.ts (the co-commit keystone), checkpoint-store.ts, watermarks.ts, transaction-lease.ts, temporal-kv.ts — each paired with its own fast .test.ts unit suite via vitest.mutation.config.ts (perTest coverage reruns only a mutant's covering tests). MEASURED BASELINE 2026-07-24 (per-adapter, single-container reuse; each adapter's own .test.ts): save-and-advance 100.00% (5 mutants), watermarks 84.21% (38), checkpoint-store 76.41% (195), temporal-kv 70.26% (195), transaction-lease 64.83% (293) => AGGREGATE 70.68% over 726 mutants (505 killed, 6 timeout, 136 survived, 76 no-coverage). The per-adapter aggregate is a conservative LOWER BOUND for this interleaved config: here each adapter's mutants ALSO get coverage from sibling suites (checkpoint-store.test.ts / save-and-advance.test.ts drive transaction-lease.ts, etc.), so no-coverage mutants can only become killed, never lowering the score. break is committed at 65 — below the measured 70.68% aggregate (honest, green-now), WELL ABOVE guideline §2.3's break:60 floor; it ratchets up and MUST NOT be lowered to pass. Per-adapter wall-clock (concurrency 3): 17s / 85s / 348s / 323s / 611s. To reproduce fast, run mutation per-adapter (single-container reuse) rather than all five interleaved (which churns a container per file-switch).
